draft.heroMessage: Serving Minneapolis & the Twin Cities with integrity and expertise.
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome to Bridge Realty, where our experience and dedication empower your next real estate move in the Twin Cities.
draft.tagline: Connecting buyers and sellers across Minneapolis, St. Paul, and the surrounding communities.
draft.aboutParagraph: Bridge Realty is the largest family-owned brokerage in the Twin Cities, serving Minneapolis, St. Paul, and surrounding areas since 2006. With a commitment to honesty, open communication, and client-first service, we specialize in residential and commercial properties including single-family homes, condos, multi-family investments, and new construction. Our client-focused team combines local market knowledge and tailored strategies to guide you through every step of your real estate journey.
draft.conciergeLine: Curious about the Twin Cities market or ready to start your search? Reach out for expert guidance and a seamless real estate experience.
draft.contactLine: Contact Bridge Realty at 952-368-0021 or Frontdesk@thebridgerealty.com to get started.
draft.tone: Warm, professional, and client-focused, emphasizing local expertise and a family-owned approach.

About Bridge Realty

Brokerage founded in 2006, Bridge Realty is the largest family-owned real estate company in the Twin Cities. We specialize in residential and commercial properties, including single-family homes, condos, multi-family investments, and new construction. Client satisfaction is our top priority, and we work with buyers and sellers across all price ranges. As Minnesota’s first 100% commission brokerage, we’re backed by a strong culture of honesty, excellence, integrity, and open communication. By connecting sellers and buyers and supporting the professional growth of our brokers, we help our community thrive.
